recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast photograph of three men in casual attire standing in a bright, mid-century modern interior. The image features a stark white background with a prominent, textured red title at the top and a smaller subtitle below it.
coreVisualRelationships: Three figures staggered in depth to create a sense of space
High-key white environment contrasting with dark clothing and shadows
Vibrant red textured title acting as the primary focal point against a neutral palette
Architectural lines of the interior framing the subjects
coreInvariants: Deep black shadows with blown-out white highlights
Distressed, blood-like or paint-splatter texture on the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three men arranged from left to right, varying in scale from mid-shot to full-body, creating a diagonal recession into the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red, textured title centered at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves down to the central figure, then sweeps left and right to the other band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space in the upper half and left side, emphasizing the subjects and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated blues and blacks (clothing and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across the image except for the high-saturation red text; high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, jagged edges suggesting liquid splatter or erosion
Distressed internal texture with highlights and shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'drips' or 'splatters' extending from the terminals
The letter 'A' and 'T' have unique distressed silhouettes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed display face paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for contrast.

preserve: Red color of the main title
avoid: Clean, modern geometric fonts for the title

candidateDirections.reason: To mimic the splattered, organic texture of the main title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Gill Sans or similar humanist sans
candidateDirections.reason: To match the clean, approachable look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, desaturated photograph of three men in casual clothing standing in a bright, white mid-century modern room with large windows and stone textures. The lighting should be blown out in the whites with deep black shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title at the top in a distressed, blood-red splatter font. Directly below it, add a smaller subtitle in a clean, dark sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the main title vibrant red and textured?
Is the photography desaturated with high contrast?
Are there three distinct subjects in the frame?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red splatter texture
Degree of desaturation in the photo

mustAchieve: Tactile texture on the red text
avoid: Generic, clean fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text looks like a physical texture (splatter/paint).
Ensure the white background doesn't lose all detail in the architecture.
Verify the subjects are desaturated but not purely grayscale.
Confirm the subtitle is legible and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key desaturated band portrait + Distressed crimson display typography + Clean sans-serif subtitle.
